title: Nashville Poolside Condo!
description:
Location, location, location. This poolside condo is the perfect space for any Nashville visit. Only 2.5 miles to Broadway and a short distance from the BEST of what Nashville has to offer: 12th South, Melrose, Downtown, Belmont, and Vandy. An inexpensive $6 Lyft/Uber ride to the rest of the best!

5 mins - Downtown Nashville (Titans/Preds/Broadway/Ryman)
5 mins - Gulch
4 mins - Geodis Park
2 mins - Great food and bars
1 min - Grocery store(Publix)
1 min - Liquor store next door

The space
This condo has 1 full king size bed and a Queen size blow up mattress. Total sleeping occupancy is 4.

Guest access
Guests will have full access to the condo and pool, minus a owner's closet.

Other things to note
You will have access to the entire condo and pool. All linens, decor, bed etc. is brand new. There is 1 king bed & 1 blow up mattress. The bed has memory foam & gel pillows. Fresh towels & linens will be provided for all guests. A stocked Keurig coffee maker will also be available to guests. There is high-speed Wi-Fi, a smart television, and an on site washer and dryer(not in unit).
*Our HOA generally opens the pool May 1st and closes the pool around September 30th of each year.
*Must be 21 years old to book.
*Max stay is 29 days
